# Media & presentations

## AIM at MIAI Days 2025

A presentation of the AIM chair by Filippo Masi was included in **MIAI Days on 19 June 2025**. The recording below begins at the AIM presentation, as linked in [Inria's TRIPOP 2025 report](https://radar.inria.fr/report/2025/tripop/index.html).
